psychological_meaning: Forest Green evokes feelings of nature, growth, and tranquility. It is associated with health, renewal, and balance, often representing stability and endurance. This color can also symbolize ambition and abundance, fostering a sense of well-being and connection to the earth.

real_world_examples.description: The lush greenery of the Amazon symbolizes life and biodiversity.

real_world_examples.title: National Park Sign
real_world_examples.description: The dark green color used in National Park signs represents preservation and natural beauty.
